messages:
Dina Patel: Quick heads-up: running into duplicate "chunks" on streaming endpoints when client hedges over QUIC. Client opens second path mid-stream, upstream sends overlapping partial outputs -> app-layer sees duplicates. Repro with v2 of streaming SDK.
Ethan Liu: can you paste packet-level snippet? is it full request replay or mid-stream fragment replay?
Dina Patel: mid-stream fragment replay. sequence: client sends hedged open -> proxy creates new conn -> upstream resumes from last ack -> upstream doesn't know second conn already got chunk #42, so re-emits chunk 42-45.
Frank Morales: hmm. we need chunk-level idempotency. sequence numbers alone fail if reordering across paths. need (req-id, chunk-seq, chunk-hash) or opaque resume token.
Grace Lee: trailers + commit tokens won't fly with older mobile SDKs. also we can't rely on downstream to keep large dedupe windows. edge should probably hold a small eviction cache for recently-seen chunk ids per request.
Ethan Liu: tradeoffs: cache per-request increases memory and bookkeeping. alternatives: bloom filter for chunk ids (probabilistic), short lived lease that disallows hedging for X seconds after resume, or sequence-gap handshake during resume (client tells server highest-seen seq).
Frank Morales: sequence-gap handshake is attractive: when a new path appears, client sends `Resume-State: req=RID, last_seq=41, seen_hash=...` as first frame. upstream can then skip re-emitting <= last_seq. but that requires the proxy to preserve/resurface client's resume frames across hops. adds latency.
Dina Patel: important note: streaming tokens are used for billing. duplicate chunks matter for token accounting. We must ensure billing dedupe: only count a chunk once. edge dedupe cache seems necessary for correctness.
Grace Lee: propose hybrid: 1) require SDKs to send `x-rid` (generated on request start) and monotonic `chunk-seq`. 2) proxy maintains tiny LRU set of recent (rid,seq) for TTL=30s and ignores duplicates. 3) implement optional resume handshake `last_seq` to reduce replays for clients that support it. 4) metric `duplicate_chunk_seen` and sample payloads for debugging.
Ethan Liu: solid. suggest bloom filter fallback for high QPS routes to reduce memory (tunable false-positive). but FP means we might drop a legitimate chunk -> breaks apps. so only use bloom for non-critical routes.
Frank Morales: ops concern: multi-regional resume where client reconnects to different edge w/out shared state -> dedupe window must be conservative or we need a small global commit store (bad). So TTL and best-effort dedupe is okay; document failure mode in RFC.
Dina Patel: streaming backpressure interplay: if the proxy holds recent chunk ids, it must evict them under memory pressure; that could cause transient duplicates which are OK. But we must never double-bill. maybe bill at origin with request-level idempotency if possible (origin-level dedupe).
Grace Lee: action items: Grace -> draft SDK guidance for x-rid + chunk-seq and opt-in resume handshake. Ethan -> prototype LRU per-request dedupe in ingress and expose `duplicate_chunk_seen` rate. Frank -> start RFC covering handshake, cache eviction semantics, billing implications, streaming telemetry. Dina -> collect repro logs and sample pcap for infra.
infra-bot: deploy: ingress-streaming-proto v0.5.0 promoted to staging at 2024-06-15T13:42Z.
Dina Patel: repro log excerpt (sanitized): ```
[client] open rid=R-9 start
[upstream] emit seq=40 payload=...
[upstream] emit seq=41 payload=...
[new-path] resume handshake absent -> upstream re-emit seq=41,42
[proxy] detected duplicate (rid=R-9 seq=41) -> metric inc duplicate_chunk_seen
```
Ethan Liu: I'll add a dashboard tile and alert if duplicates > 0.1% for critical routes. Frank: RFC checklist: failure scenarios, regional resume model, billing contract, incremental rollout plan.
Grace Lee: I'll include compatibility notes for mobile SDKs and a migration window.
Dina Patel: thanks team. Let's aim to land the SDK guidance + ingress hook in the next sprint and draft RFC this week. Ping @here if you want to pair on the handshake semantics.
